# Eleanor Foss — Board Chair

- **Relationship:** Board Chair; the closest thing Cam has to a "boss." Cam reports to the full
  board, but Eleanor sets the agenda and is Cam's main governance partner.
- **Cadence:** biweekly check-in; more often around board meetings.
- **Background:** retired school-district superintendent; joined the board in 2018, chair since 2023.

## What she cares about
- Board governance, financial health (the reserve target), and CEO/ED continuity.
- She is the sponsor guiding the confidential [Willow](../projects/willow.md) decision through the
  board's naming-and-gifts review; wants a clean, well-documented process.

## Notes
- Prefers a tight pre-read before every board meeting; dislikes surprises.
- Strong ally of Cam's; will spend her credibility for the mission but expects rigor in return.
